function negate(value:number|bigint){return -value;}
function invert(value:number|bigint){return ~value;}
function generic<T extends number|bigint>(value:T){return -value;}
const negative:number=negate(1n);
const complement:number=invert(1n);
const constrained:number=generic(1n);
function plus(value:number|bigint){return +value;}
function genericPlus<T extends number|bigint>(value:T){return +value;}
